purpose: Conceptual data contract for the React visualization of the CK3 PT-BR neuro-symbolic learning network.

learning_cycle_gate.last_objective: Create follow-up microdiagnostics for queue 115 lexical/domain blockers

groups.label: Deterministic Guards
groups.description: Authoritative structural gates that protect CK3 localization syntax before ML decisions can matter.

groups.label: Macro Model
groups.description: General risk classifier that scores the full package and acts as broad baseline.

groups.label: Coordinator / Ensemble
groups.description: Routing and arbitration layer that chooses specialists, compares evidence, and keeps decisions auditable.

groups.label: Operational Specialists
groups.description: Domain specialists and legacy experts for areas such as religion, titles and cultural labels.

groups.label: Experimental Subagents
groups.description: Narrow skill-based agents trained on issue families, partial repairs and shadow policies.

groups.label: Lifecycle Policies
groups.description: Governed policies that move evidence through shadow, checkpoint, lifecycle and guarded release.

groups.label: Production Output
groups.description: Final output writing layer, separated from learning and guarded by dry-run, token policy and snapshots.

nodes.label: Deterministic Guards
nodes.description: Protects keys, line structure, placeholders, CK3 tokens, blanks, locked human decisions and token policy violations.
risks: false block can slow production
rule drift after CK3 syntax changes
next_steps: keep authoritative
instrument blocker counts by rule family

nodes.label: Trusted Translation Memory
nodes.description: Stores human confirmations, locked exceptions, approved repairs and game-tested output as evidence rather than blind truth.
risks: stale memory when source semantics change
old trusted text can encode legacy mistakes
next_steps: continue hash-based stale checks
separate production feedback from training evidence

nodes.label: Macro Risk Model v0038
nodes.description: Current promoted general classifier. It sees the broad package and remains active because newer candidates lowered operational safe recall.
risks: generic model can miss specialized CK3 patterns
newer datasets do not automatically mean better promotion
next_steps: use as stable baseline
promote only when candidate improves coverage without false-safe regression

nodes.label: Latest Macro Candidate v0427
nodes.description: Most recent trained classifier. It has zero false-safe in holdout but lower safe recall, so it is not promoted.
risks: over-conservative candidate may inflate pending counts
promotion would reduce operational coverage
next_steps: train more targeted evidence
compare against active model by production-relevant cohorts

nodes.label: Coordinator Ensemble v1
nodes.description: Routes segments and issues to macro, specialists, subagents and lifecycle gates. It organizes evidence rather than allowing each agent to close output alone.
risks: scope-sum routed count is not unique segment count
routing sample limit can hide tail behavior
next_steps: instrument unique routed segments
surface when a missing specialist should be created

nodes.label: Agent Registry
nodes.description: Catalog of macro, guards, specialists, microagents, symbolic subpolicies and lifecycle actors.
risks: many planned/experimental agents can visually look like failures if not labelled as lab work
unregistered legacy microagents contain useful evidence but are not yet first-class routed agents
next_steps: separate operational authority from evidence-only status in visualization
promote useful legacy microagents into registered lab or operational tiers
collapse stale_or_unproven and planned_backlog by default

nodes.label: Religion Specialist
nodes.description: Operational specialist for religion terminology, divine references and preserved religious terms.
risks: some divine names must be preserved while others translate semantically
next_steps: keep subagents narrow
use feedback from religion_semantic_microagent

nodes.label: Titles Specialist Legacy
nodes.description: Legacy broad title specialist. It remains useful as evidence, but broad title logic has known ambiguity and experimental false-safe history.
risks: broad title category mixes names to preserve, names to translate, gendered adjectives and structural exceptions
next_steps: keep evidence-only until subagents absorb reliable patterns
prefer title_policy_microagent and culture_title_labels for narrow cases

nodes.label: Culture Title Labels
nodes.description: Operational specialist for cultural title labels and culture/title naming conventions.
risks: culture labels can look like ordinary titles but carry historical naming constraints
next_steps: continue policy-by-group strategy

nodes.label: Issue Ledger
nodes.description: Breaks pending segments into issue-level units so several microagents can work on one segment before a final composition audit.
risks: coverage of issues is not the same as closing a segment
duplicate or overlapping issue families need composition rules
next_steps: use coverage as queue source
audit full-coverage candidates before lifecycle closure

nodes.label: Short Label Style Microagent
nodes.description: Handles compact UI labels and short texts. This is the largest open issue family and the highest-impact next area.
risks: short labels can hide semantic mismatch
clean exactness is not always semantic correctness
next_steps: integrate guarded lifecycle only after visual/readiness review
expand by subfamilies instead of one broad rule

nodes.label: Custom Localization Fragment Microagent
nodes.description: Specializes in short custom-localization fragments that are safe only when their key, file lane and fragment role indicate a clean localizable word or tiny phrase.
risks: domain adjectives can look like ordinary Portuguese words
file-level calibration is not enough for broad promotion
next_steps: repair PT-BR flower variants such as papoulas and áster before lifecycle closure
create a native dog-breed preservation microagent for cases like asong gubat
review another strong-candidate slice before considering lifecycle authority

nodes.label: Custom Localization Composition Auditor
nodes.description: Audits whether custom_localization segments with fully covered issue families are mature enough for whole-segment recheck. It measures composition opportunity only and has no output authority.
risks: full issue coverage is not the same as safe whole-segment closure
semantic-only candidates may hide file-lane context errors
next_steps: keep composition auditor in shadow until more slices confirm precision
route PT-BR flower style repairs to a small lexical microagent
route native breed/name preservation to a domain microagent

nodes.label: PT-BR Flower Lexicon Microagent
nodes.description: Learns narrow PT-BR lexical repairs for flower labels discovered by custom_localization composition recheck failures, such as papoila->papoula, aster->áster and peonía->peônia.
risks: botanical names can be common names, latinized names, or intentionally preserved cultural terms
mojibake-like strings require manual confirmation before repair
next_steps: convert checkpointed repairs into a production-flow proposal only after review
split botanical domain-review cases into a separate preservation/translation policy

nodes.label: Native Dog Type Preservation Microagent
nodes.description: Detects dog type labels where English and Spanish preserve a native breed/name but PT-BR translated or morphologically localized it, requiring a preservation policy before closure.
risks: some breed names can have accepted Portuguese forms
preserving every English/Spanish identical dog type would be too broad
next_steps: review asong gubat and telomian as a tiny domain policy
decide whether native multiword names and latinized breed names should be preserved or localized

nodes.label: Short Label Bold-No Repair
nodes.description: Narrow subagent that repairs CK3 visible markup from #bold No#!/#bold no#!/#BOLD No#! to PT-BR #bold Não#!/#bold não#!/#BOLD Não#! when no other residual blocker remains.
outputs: blocked residual cases for broader repair neurons
risks: does not repair Spanish that remains outside the bold No marker
issue coverage is not output application
next_steps: promote only through lifecycle after final production policy review
route the 5 blocked cases to Spanish residual and punctuation repair lanes

nodes.label: Dynamic CK3 Expression Microagent
nodes.description: Understands CK3 dynamic expressions such as Custom helpers and Select_CString branches. Current focus is no-op and literal-payload handling.
risks: nested Select_CString expressions may not be parsed by simple regex
literal Spanish inside dynamic payload may require semantic rewrite
next_steps: review 240-item repair queue
split local-player Spanish literal payload into smaller correction agents
then attack ES_OA/ES_ElLa/ES_DelDela custom helpers

nodes.label: Select_CString Local Player Preterite Verb
nodes.description: Learns Spanish second-person preterite literals in local-player Select_CString branches before PT-BR rewrite.
risks: Spanish verb pair recognition is not yet a PT-BR translation
requires final segment/context composition before closure
next_steps: expand evidence beyond 45-row validation sample
isolate boundary verbs that require context
only then create a repair shadow policy

nodes.label: Select_CString Local Player Reflexive Phrase
nodes.description: Learns reflexive branch shifts such as second-person local-player phrase to third-person phrase.
risks: reflexive phrasing may need semantic context
wrong reflexive target can change meaning
next_steps: sample-review reflexive pairs
separate tense/current-state subpatterns

nodes.label: Select_CString Local Player Possessive Pronoun
nodes.description: Learns possessive local-player branch shifts such as tus to sus before PT-BR final wording.
risks: Portuguese may need seu/sua/seus/suas depending on noun gender and number
branch simplification can hide visible grammar issues
next_steps: connect with gender token microagent
require noun agreement evidence before rewrite

nodes.label: Gender Token Microagent
nodes.description: Validates gender helper usage, pronoun surfaces and gendered endings without allowing unsafe token drift.
risks: PT-BR fluency may require intentional structural divergence from Spanish mirror
wrong helper can create visible gender bugs
next_steps: mature evidence before production authority
separate pronoun, article and adjective-ending subpatterns

nodes.label: Spanish Residual Microagent
nodes.description: Detects and repairs actual Spanish residue while avoiding false alarms caused by CK3 keys, names or package language identifiers.
risks: proper names may resemble Spanish
Spanish source package labels should not be treated as localization residue
next_steps: classify 8 unclassified boundaries
promote only same-token repairs with clean shadow behavior

nodes.label: Autofix Unknown Router
nodes.description: Splits token-safe pending items where the model requests autofix but no current specialist explains the issue. Reviewed safe UI surfaces can now pass through a guarded lifecycle bridge, but this agent still does not write production output.
outputs: guarded lifecycle closures for reviewed safe surfaces
risks: surface clusters can mix real UI with narrative prose containing markup
safe_surface evidence is not segment-level production authority
next_steps: create warning/list/confirmation microagents only after more reviewed evidence
keep event/building/plain prose as semantic review queues

nodes.label: Long Text Composer
nodes.description: Combines partial repairs from multiple microagents in long or mixed segments, then requires final recheck before segment closure.
risks: partial repairs can conflict when merged
segment-level closure requires final holistic validation
next_steps: use recheck queue before lifecycle closure
instrument composition precision

nodes.label: Semantic Review Router
nodes.description: Large open family for semantic review routing. It currently identifies need for semantic attention more than it fixes text.
risks: too broad to become one reliable repair agent
semantic similarity cannot be inferred from tokens alone
next_steps: split into short-label semantic pairs, event surface, religion/culture/title semantic families

nodes.label: Shadow + Checkpoint Lifecycle
nodes.description: Moves candidates from evidence to shadow, checkpoint, lifecycle observation and guarded release without directly authorizing output writes.
risks: visual dashboards can confuse shadow readiness with production authority
next_steps: show authority badges: decision_authorized, evidence_only, planned_only

nodes.label: Segment State Snapshot
nodes.description: Materializes current lifecycle state for each active localization segment without modifying output.
risks: raw pending includes watch/model suspicion, not all manual work
closed does not imply output was just written
next_steps: keep separating actionable pending, watch and lifecycle backlog

nodes.label: Production Runner
nodes.description: Runs preflight, snapshots, dry-runs, token policy checks, controlled writes and post-write audits through the separate production flow.
risks: must not run while learning_status is locked
production writes are outside this learning thread
next_steps: keep production in chat 2
only run full production after meaningful guarded gains

edges.label: issue coverage for custom localization segments
routes flower lexical blockers from composition review
stages high-confidence flower lexical repair evidence
dynamic no-op and repair shadow candidates
evidence only, future shadow repair candidate
production feedback can become future evidence

status_legend.operational: can participate in active decision flow
status_legend.shadow: learning/evidence mode, no production authority by itself
status_legend.candidate: trained or prepared but not promoted
status_legend.experimental_watch: useful evidence with known laboratory risk

authority_legend.broad_risk_classifier: scores risk but does not write output
authority_legend.route_and_arbitrate: combines evidence and decides next route
authority_legend.domain_vote: specialist vote in a limited scope
authority_legend.problem_level_memory: stores issues and coverage, not a final decision
authority_legend.safe_output_writer: only layer allowed to write output through production flow

show_as_attention: safe recall regression in macro candidates
dynamic Select_CString Spanish literal repair queue
